correctness.rationale: PASS: For each site E_i(X)=|φ_i><φ_i|_i⊗tr_i X is CPTP, idempotent and pairwise commuting. Conditional on selected sites V, T^m=∑_V p(V)E_V; on full V, E_V=R. Hence T^m=(1-p_m)R+p_m N_m, giving diamond upper bound 2p_m even with an arbitrary reference. An input tensor product of local states orthogonal to φ_i leaves at least one orthogonal factor for every incomplete V, so its output is block-orthogonal to |Φ>, saturating 2p_m; ancillas cannot help. Inclusion–exclusion yields exact weighted tail for m=0 as well (0^0=1); binomial factorial domination yields limit 1−exp(−e^(−c)) at m=n log n+cn and epsilon quantile. The fair-bit classical hypercube TV upper bound by Walsh chi-square and lower bound by magnetization variance establish (1/2+o(1))nlogn in same update normalization. Independently computed 36 exact rational mask distributions, all matching weighted inclusion-exclusion, for n=1,2,3 and m=0..8; the structural diamond proof, not masks, handles all reference ancillas and dimensions.
